content_sections.heading: DRDO GTRE Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Other Conditions: Applicants must have had an unblemished service record and effective communication and interpersonal skills. There must be a gap of fifteen (15) days between retirement and appointment as a consultant. Persons with experience working with DRDO are accorded preference.

rows.qualification_required: Retired from Central / State Govts, PSUs, Autonomous Bodies, Universities, Govt. R&D Organizations at Pay Level-12. Possessing practical knowledge, adequate experience in Data Acquisition and Monitoring System (DAMS) with electronics domain expertise, technical co-ordination for demand purchase activities, and technical documentation/engine test reports.

Retired from Central / State Govts, PSUs, Autonomous Bodies, Universities, Govt. R&D Organizations at Pay Level-11. Possessing practical knowledge, adequate experience in Technical Photography, Videography and Visual Documentation related to engine testing, rig testing, component documentation, project activities, institutional events and official functions.

Retired from Central / State Govts, PSUs, Autonomous Bodies, Universities, Govt. R&D Organizations at Pay Level-6. Possessing practical knowledge, adequate experience in HR domain to manage HRD activities such as training need identification, higher studies schemes, CEPs, orientation programmes, apprentice training, and related administrative tasks.

content_sections.heading: DRDO GTRE Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process involves preliminary screening of applications by a locally-constituted Committee, followed by a duly-constituted Screening Committee to assess suitability and shortlist candidates based on eligibility criteria, TOR, GFR provisions, and relevant guidelines. The merit-wise panel recommended by the Screening Committee remains valid for six (06) months.

Ensure applications are received on or before 29 October 2026. Applications received after the closing date are rejected automatically.

faq.question: Q1. What is DRDO GTRE Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an official recruitment notification issued by Gas Turbine Research Establishment (DRDO GTRE), Bengaluru, to engage retired government employees as Consultants on a short-term contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in DRDO GTRE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available across Pay Level-6, Pay Level-11, and Pay Level-12 posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit applications for DRDO GTRE Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications is 29 October 2026 (within 21 days from the date of publication).

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible to apply for DRDO GTRE Consultant positions?
faq.answer: Retired employees from Central / State Governments, PSUs, Autonomous Bodies, Universities, and Govt R&D Organizations who retired at the prescribed pay levels (Level-6, Level-11, or Level-12) can apply.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for DRDO GTRE Consultant engagement?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit of the applicant shall not be more than 63 years as on the closing date for receipt of applications.
